retired: deleted by phase-482 W6 with every other deprecated item; the row records the rename
why:
phase-408 / issue 0964. The `_sized` twin of the call above it: the caller states the receive capacity instead of the message type deriving it. rclcpp has no counterpart because it has an ALLOCATOR — a receive buffer there grows, so no caller ever names a capacity. Here the buffer is a fixed stack array and the number decides whether a sample fits or is truncated, so a type with no derived bound needs a way for its caller to say what it can afford. Without these, moving the receive buffers off the estimate would have had exactly one remedy (bound the type); now it has two.

phase-456 W2b — this row moved from `cpp:Subscription::try_recv_validated_sized`. The method did not change; the class it lives on did. `Subscription<M>` served both the dispatch and the poll owner behind a `callback_mode_` flag, and every method here dereferences `storage_`, which only the poll owner has.

RETIRED by phase-482 W6 (2026-10-07): the deprecated item is DELETED, with every other deprecated item in the tree as one batch (changelog.d/+phase-482-w6.breaking.md). Code that still names it gets an undeclared-identifier error naming nothing; the changelog entry carries the replacement. The row is kept as the record of the rename.
